title: Release publish
description: Publishes each host package the project's build wrote to its host's package server, skipping distributions the server holds and a project nx release left unversioned

registry.description: Package server URL nx release publish passes as --registry, in place of the host's default server

dryRun.description: Reads the packages and the server and prints each upload without sending it

nxReleaseVersionData.description: Versions nx release resolved per project
